observed_bottleneck: Parent n-c555e44c6daf publishes a 512-dimensional embedding obtained by uniformly mean-pooling recurrent states trained only for next-token likelihood, so its exact GP receives no corpus-level pressure for graph-local molecular neighborhoods. Although all 450 Parent fits are positive definite and assimilate every observation, 130 of 435 disposable-clone updates reduce paired posterior-mean reward, and sitagliptin_mpo has pooled lift only 0.00011006466612005493. Representation-only node n-d3657d86652a further shows that changing this frozen geometry can matter, with a +0.02482218848232635 mean paired score change, but its one-axis length deletion regresses seed 2 and two task means, so indiscriminate nuisance removal is not stable enough. Node n-f851988d522a instead reduced in-table graph-equivalent posterior disagreement by repeating five labeled views, yet lowered seed-0 macro score by 0.15944257826084401 and weakened acquisition pressure. The limiting behavior is therefore a frozen representation whose distances are not explicitly trained to preserve unlabeled graph neighborhoods, not missing observation assimilation or a need for repeated labeled views.
hypothesis: Distill fixed radius-2 molecular-fingerprint geometry into the frozen corpus representation: fit one task-agnostic ridge map from the Parent-equivalent mean-pooled GRU embeddings of unlabeled corpus molecules to their graph fingerprints, then publish the normalized mapped vector as the unchanged-width sequence embedding.
method_thesis: Pretrain a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model and its sequence representation only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, retain a frozen prior, and restart all task-local state for each independent objective. Fit a probabilistic surrogate only to the ten fixed scored molecules and subsequent oracle-evaluated molecules, while maintaining an oracle-anchor policy updated only from returned true scores. Before each evaluator-announced batch, clone that anchor into a disposable inner policy, optimize the clone without oracle calls using the surrogate posterior mean as its molecular reward, and ancestrally sample a fresh ephemeral set of complete SMILES from the resulting policy. Canonicalize locally, remove invalid, previously evaluated, and duplicate molecules, and select the requested number by greedy batch expected improvement; after feedback, refit the surrogate, update the oracle anchor from the real observations, and discard the inner clone. Thus every submitted molecule is generated de novo, the corpus is never scored or searched as a candidate pool, and surrogate feedback changes the source distribution itself before acquisition rather than merely ranking proposals from a fixed generator. The optimization target is solely the equal-weight mean of the five independent terminal Top-1 scores.
